messages:
elena (Support): Fwd from OmegaCo — they say embeddings output length jumped after we rollforward-pinned the model earlier today. Customer expects 1024 dims, getting 1536.

sam (OmegaCo): Hi, we called embeddings for our index build at 09:12 UTC and saw this. Example response: `{"model":"open-embed-v2","vector": [0.12, ...], "length":1536}`. Our code asserts 1024 and fails.

maria (SRE): Noted. Did they pin a specific variant? Any model id in their call?

sam (OmegaCo): They passed model: `redwood/open-embed-v2:locked-2026-03-16` — we think this is the pinned variant.

elena (Support): Repro steps customer provided: 1) POST /v1/embeddings with model=redwood/open-embed-v2:locked-2026-03-16 2) payload with 1000 short docs 3) got back vectors length 1536. They say it started when your ops team run the pin rollforward at ~08:40 UTC.

devin (Eng-ML): Hmm. Could be alias -> variant mapping changed to a quantized/alternative topology that emits 1536 dims. Asking for raw request headers and full JSON body. Also checking model catalog mapping.

elena (Support): Sent customer request/headers in DM. They attached a curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-omega" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood/open-embed-v2:locked-2026-03-16","input":["foo","bar"]}'
```

devin (Eng-ML): Quick check: rollout logs show a pin alias update at 08:37 UTC where alias `open-embed-v2:locked-2026-03-16` was remapped to a variant id with a different output head (internal id v2-q1536). That explains dim change. Investigating why the variant selection allowed head mismatch.

anne (Platform): Deploy-bot log attached: `deploy-bot: alias-update open-embed-v2:locked-2026-03-16 -> variant:v2-q1536 (2026-03-16T08:37:12Z)`. This was intended to switch to a quantized build for performance but the alias should have preserved output shape. Looks like a metadata mis-tag.

maria (SRE): Customer impact: schema mismatch causing index build to fail. Proposed immediate action: (A) map the alias back to previous variant (v2-1024) until metadata fixed; (B) create a compatibility shim that rejects calls to mismatch-shaped variants with clear 400 error and message. Which to do first?

devin (Eng-ML): Rollback alias (A) now. Also will add a triage check in model-catalog to validate embedding_head_size vs advertised output_shape before alias flip.

anne (Platform): Rolling alias back now.
deploy-bot: alias-update open-embed-v2:locked-2026-03-16 -> variant:v2-1024 (2026-03-16T09:02:05Z)

anne (Platform): Back to v2-1024. Please confirm from customer.

sam (OmegaCo): Confirmed — we retried at 09:05 UTC and now vectors are length 1024. Our ingest completed. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

elena (Support): Follow-ups: ops/eng please add an automated pre-flip check for output dims and add a postmortem entry. I've opened CS ticket #CS-7891 and CC'd the customer.

devin (Eng-ML): Will add fix and unit test. Also adding a metric alert if alias flips to a variant with different embedding_head_size than previous live variant.

maria (SRE): I'll open a short incident doc and schedule a 30-min retro.

elena (Support): Marking resolved for now. Customer satisfied. :white_check_mark:
